verdict.claim: Did the vendor contractually commit to 99.9% uptime?
verdict.reasoning: The evidence packet contains no signed or authoritative record explicitly establishing a contractual commitment to 99.9% uptime. The Support Addendum draft mentions evaluating a 99.9% availability target, but it is not binding until signed. The signed Support Addendum only commits to 99.5% monthly availability. The Master Service Agreement explicitly states that no service level agreement, guaranteed uptime percentage, service credit, or remedy for downtime is established in the agreement itself. Marketing statements and sales discussions are deemed non-binding unless expressly incorporated into a signed order form. The engineering lead mentioned a 99.9% availability target after Q4, but the account manager clarified it was a planning target, not an executed SLA. No one approved a 99.9% contractual uptime commitment in the Steering Approval Log.
